scope.counting: files counts unique current physical files; inputs/code are lookup aliases, not additional entries. Five placeholders are explicitly future binding groups, not five predicted future files. OUT denotes an as-yet-unspecified run output directory; null paths have no invented bytes or digests.
scope.current_data: The seven data inputs include render_config_v2.json. Protected-region logic is counted once as source code. Brick/no-r files are read for integrity only, not decoded by this adapter.
scope.own_bytecode: Eight existing cached copies remain explicitly pinned. The consumer checks every cache digest and code-object equality to pinned source, and rejects currently discoverable standard caches missing from CORE. No cache or installed-library tree is swept. Custom import loaders, unobserved runtime mutation and third-party caches are not a complete-byte guarantee.
scope.runtime: Only the runtime register document is referenced here. Its three artifact pins, versions and lock values live in RUNTIME_PINS_A1_CORE.json.
scope.inventory_disposition: Retained unchanged as inventory artefacts, NOT the manifest. Their 1,529/359 and 1,521/422 historical counts do not determine CORE readiness.
scope.excluded_provenance: Input builders, source catalogues/failed-source CSV, receipts, A1 prose/adoption records and approval recorder are not run_path file reads; their lineage or procedural roles do not make them current run data/code entries.
scope.self: run_path.read_pin(C) consumes the manifest document itself. Its final full-file digest is external, in the authoring report and eventual independently supplied C pin; no self-referential entry.
scope.output_only: Started/abort records and terminal validation record/render/scores/configurations are written, not subsequently read by this driver, so they are not invented input placeholders. Validation tensors and retained planes ARE read and appear in stage bindings.
scope.trace_limits: V45 static/import trace plus V46 bounded consumer and synthetic integration checks. Only named current metadata/code/runtime bytes are rehashed; no actual study stage, network fetch, real pixel/label access or scientific run is performed. Runtime dependencies are governed by the bounded runtime contract, not asserted byte-complete.
